kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-detect-porn-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T09:00:00Z --app 'liveApp****' --stream 'liveStream****' --fee free --scene porn --biz-region cn-shanghai --split-by 'liveApp****,liveStream****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveDetectPornData

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain of the streamer to query.
You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live domain names is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的主播流域名。
支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. You can query data of the last 90 days at most. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. If this parameter is left empty, the data of the last 24 hours is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 最多可获取最近90天的数据。 最小数据粒度为5分钟，取值为空则默认获取最近24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en:
The billing type. You have a free daily quota for image scanning. Valid values:

free
charge
parameters.help_zh:
用户每天拥有免费的图片扫描额度。取值：

free
charge
parameters.name: fee

parameters.help_en:
The detection scenario. Valid values:

porn (default): pornography detection.
terrorism: terrorism and political content detection.
ad: image and text violation detection.
live: inappropriate live streaming scenarios.
logo: logo detection
parameters.help_zh:
检测场景。取值：

porn（默认值）：鉴黄。
terrorism：暴恐涉政。
ad：图文违规。
live：不良直播场景。
logo：logo检测
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en: The region to which the domain name belongs
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The list of grouping fields. Separate multiple fields with commas (,).

If SplitBy is left empty, only TimeStamp and Count are returned
parameters.help_zh:
分组字段列表。多个字段用英文逗号（,）分隔。

当SplitBy为空时，仅返回TimeStamp和Count
parameters.name: split_by
